scenes.title: Mimi Kitten and the Rolling Yarn Ball
scenes.subtitle: A Kids Story  •  Honey Bunny Kidz

lines.text: Honey Bunny Kidz presents: Mimi Kitten and the Rolling Yarn Ball!
Once upon a time, in a little cottage with a red roof, lived a tiny kitten named Mimi.
Mimi had soft, fluffy fur, a curly orange tail, and a pink collar with a little gold bell.
Meow! Hello, friends! My name is Mimi.
Mimi's favorite toy was a round, pink yarn ball. She loved it very, very much.
Look at my yarn ball! It is soft and pink, and it rolls and rolls!
Mimi gave her yarn ball a little pat with her paw. Pat, pat!
Oh no! The yarn ball rolled away. It rolled down the little garden path. Roll, roll, roll!
Come back, yarn ball! Wait for me!
Mimi ran after it as fast as her little paws could go.
In the garden, Mimi met her friend, Honey Bunny.
Hello, Mimi! Why are you running?
Hello, Honey! My pink yarn ball rolled away. Can you help me find it?
Of course! Friends help friends. Let's look together!
They looked at a big green bush. It was full of pretty red roses.
I see something red! Is it your yarn ball?
No, those are red roses. My yarn ball is pink.
Can you see the red roses? Point to them!
Then, they looked up, up, up, at a very tall flower.
I see something yellow! Is it your yarn ball?
No, that is a yellow sunflower. My yarn ball is pink.
Can you see the yellow sunflower? Point to it!
Where can my yarn ball be?
Let's look by the pond!
By the blue pond sat Dotty the Duckling. And right next to Dotty was something round and pink!
My yarn ball! I found it!
Hello, Mimi! This pink ball rolled right to me. Is it yours?
Yes, it is mine! Thank you, Dotty.
You're welcome. It is so pretty. I have never played with a yarn ball before.
Mimi looked at her yarn ball. Then she looked at Dotty. Mimi had a kind idea.
Dotty, would you like to play with my yarn ball too? Let's all play together!
Oh, yes please! Thank you, Mimi!
Hooray! Sharing is caring!
So the three friends played a rolling game. Let's roll the yarn ball with them!
Roll to Honey!
Roll to Dotty!
Roll to Mimi!
They rolled it again, and again, and again. They giggled and laughed all afternoon.
Playing together is so much more fun than playing alone!
And Mimi was right. When we share our toys, everyone can have fun, and we make our friends happy too.
When the sun began to set, Mimi carried her yarn ball home.
Thank you for helping me, Honey. Today was the best day! Purr, purr.
See you tomorrow, Mimi!
Can you remember? What colors did Mimi see today? Red roses, a yellow sunflower, a blue pond, and a pink yarn ball!
The end. See you next time on Honey Bunny Kidz!

scenes.title: Lulu Lamb's Pumpkin Counting Song
scenes.subtitle: A Sing-Along Rhyme  •  Honey Bunny Kidz

lines.text: Honey Bunny Kidz presents: Lulu Lamb's Pumpkin Counting Song! Get your clapping hands ready!
It was a cool autumn afternoon. Crunchy leaves danced on Honey's front porch.
Mama Bunny, tomorrow is Dress-Up Day! Can we make the porch pretty?
Yes, Lulu! Let's paint little pumpkins. We use soft brushes and paint. No cutting at all.
Ooh! And I will make up a counting song. Every time we count, we clap!
Can you clap your hands with me? Ready?
Clap! Clap!
Yay! Great clapping!
Honey Bunny hopped up with a round, orange pumpkin.
I painted a big smile on mine! It's a happy face!
Can you make a happy face too? Show me your biggest smile!
What a lovely smile!
One little pumpkin, orange as the sun. Happy, happy face! Counting is fun!
Clap! Clap!
Quack quack! Here is my pumpkin. It is little, just like me.
What color is Dotty's pumpkin? Can you say it?
Yellow! Yes! A sunny yellow pumpkin.
I painted a sleepy face. Yawn! It wants a nap.
Two little pumpkins, one is yellow too. Sleepy, sleepy face! Yawn, like I do!
Clap! Clap!
Meow! My pumpkin is white, like your soft wool, Lulu!
And look at its face! One eye is closed, and the tongue is out!
It's a silly face! Hee hee! Can you make a silly face?
Ha ha! So silly!
Three little pumpkins, white as milk can be. Silly, silly face! Hee, hee, hee!
Clap! Clap!
Woof woof! Here is my green pumpkin! It has a surprised face. Oh!
Round eyes and a round mouth. Oh! Can you say oh, like Pip's pumpkin?
Four little pumpkins, green one by the door. Surprised, surprised face! Oh! Let's count some more!
Clap! Clap!
Four pumpkins! Woof!
Oh! My song needs five pumpkins. But I was so busy singing, I forgot to paint mine!
That's okay, Lulu. We can help you!
Mama Bunny brought one more little coral pumpkin. Honey painted the eyes, Dotty painted the cheeks, and Mimi and Pip painted a giggly smile.
Thank you, friends! When we help each other, it's even more fun.
Here is the last verse. Clap with me!
Five little pumpkins, sitting in a line. Giggly, giggly face! Friends make it shine!
Clap! Clap!
Which pumpkin has a giggly face? Can you point to it?
There it is! The coral one!
Now everybody, sing the whole song together!
One little pumpkin, orange as the sun. Happy, happy face! Counting is fun!
Clap! Clap!
Two little pumpkins, one is yellow too. Sleepy, sleepy face! Yawn, like I do!
Clap! Clap!
Three little pumpkins, white as milk can be. Silly, silly face! Hee, hee, hee!
Clap! Clap!
Four little pumpkins, green one by the door. Surprised, surprised face! Oh! Let's count some more!
Clap! Clap!
Five little pumpkins, sitting in a line. Giggly, giggly face! Friends make it shine!
Clap! Clap!
One, two, three, four, five!
Clap, clap, hooray!
The sun went down, soft and pink. The five pumpkins smiled on the porch.
Let's do a slow pumpkin breath. Breathe in, and make your tummy round like a pumpkin.
And breathe out, slowly. Ahhh.
Which pumpkin face is your favorite? Happy, sleepy, silly, surprised, or giggly?
I like them all!
See you tomorrow for Dress-Up Day! Woof!
Counting is fun, and helping friends is even better. Bye bye, friends! See you next time on Honey Bunny Kidz!

scenes.title: Lulu Lamb's First Sleepover
scenes.subtitle: A Bedtime Story  •  Honey Bunny Kidz

lines.text: Honey Bunny Kidz presents: Lulu Lamb's First Sleepover!
The sun was going down. The sky was pink and purple and orange.
Honey Bunny was playing with her new friend, a fluffy little lamb named Lulu.
Lulu had soft white wool, floppy pink ears, and a pretty purple bow.
Baa! Honey, tonight is my very first sleepover!
Yay! You can stay at my house, under the big oak tree!
Lulu's mama gave her a big hug and said she would come back in the morning.
Bye bye, Mama. See you in the morning!
Then Mama Bunny came out with a warm, happy smile.
Hello, Lulu! Welcome! Come inside, little ones. It is almost bedtime.
Come on, Lulu! Let's brush our teeth and put on our pajamas.
Okay! Brush, brush, brush!
Soon, Honey and Lulu were tucked into the cozy bed. The night light glowed soft and yellow.
Honey closed her eyes. But Lulu did not. Lulu held her blanket tight.
Honey, I feel a little bit shy. This is not my bed. And I miss my mama.
That's okay, Lulu. I feel shy sometimes too.
When I feel a little shy at night, I play a special game. It is called the thank you game.
The thank you game? How do we play?
We think of happy things from our day. And we say thank you for each one. Let's count them together!
I'll go first! Number one.
Honey remembered the morning, by the sparkly blue pond.
Thank you, Dotty Duckling, for the fun splashing game!
Quack quack! Splish, splash!
That was so much fun! Thank you, Dotty!
Now me! Number two.
Lulu remembered lunchtime, at Mimi Kitten's little cottage.
Thank you, Mimi Kitten, for sharing your yummy apple slices!
Meow! You are welcome, Lulu. Sharing is fun!
Number three! Thank you, big orange sun, for a warm and happy day.
Number four! Thank you, Honey, for being my friend.
Aww. Thank you, Lulu! I am so happy you are here.
Back in the cozy bed, Lulu smiled a big, sleepy smile. She did not feel shy anymore.
Number five! Thank you, Mama Bunny, for the warm bed and the snuggly blanket.
You are very welcome, sweet Lulu.
Just then, the big round moon peeked in through the window.
Hello, little ones. I heard you saying thank you. That is a very kind thing to do.
Thank you, Moon, for your soft, gentle light!
Goodnight, Honey. Goodnight, Lulu. Sweet dreams.
Let's count all the thank yous together. One, two, three, four, five.
Honey yawned a little yawn. Lulu yawned a little yawn too.
Goodnight, Honey.
Goodnight, Lulu.
And with happy hearts, full of thank yous, the two little friends fell fast asleep.
When you go to bed tonight, what will you say thank you for?

scenes.subtitle: A Bedtime Story  •  Honey Bunny Kidz

lines.text: Honey Bunny Kidz presents: Honey Bunny's Dress-Up Day Goodnight!
Today was Dress-Up Day! Honey Bunny hopped into her playroom in her very own costume.
Mama, look at me! I am round, and I have little yellow seeds, and a green leafy hat!
Oh my! You are a sweet little strawberry!
What color is my strawberry costume? Can you tell me?
Red! Yes, it's red! Red like a juicy strawberry.
Your friends are coming over for a dress-up parade. I wonder what they will be?
Knock, knock!
In came Mimi Kitten, all yellow and twinkly.
Twinkle, twinkle! Hello, Honey! Can you guess what shape I am?
You are a star! A big, bright star!
My star has pointy points. Let's count them together. Ready?
One. Two. Three. Four. Five!
Five points! Mimi, you are the twinkliest star!
Then Pip Puppy marched in, in a red helmet and a yellow coat with shiny stripes.
Woof! Hello, friends! What am I dressed as? Can you guess?
I am a firefighter! A pretend one.
Firefighters are brave helpers. They help people stay safe.
And today, I will help my friends! That's my job.
Time for the dress-up parade! Everyone, round the rug we go!
March, march, round we go! Dress-up friends all in a row!
Can you march with us? Lift your knees up high. March, march!
A strawberry, a fire pup, a twinkly star. Wave hello, wherever you are!
Now twirl around, slowly, like a spinning top. Can you twirl too?
Clap! Clap!
But then, wobble, wobble! Pip's big helmet slid down over his eyes.
Oopsie! Everything is dark! I can't see my friends!
Don't worry, Pip. I can help! I'll push your helmet up, nice and gently.
Peekaboo! I can see again! Thank you, Mimi. You helped the helper!
Soon the sky turned pink. The sun was going down, and it was time to go home with their mamas.
Bye bye, Honey! That was the best parade ever!
Goodnight, little strawberry! See you tomorrow!
Bye bye, friends! Can you wave goodbye too? Wave, wave!
After bath time, it was nearly bedtime. But Honey was still holding her strawberry costume.
Mama, can I sleep in my strawberry costume? I love being a strawberry.
Costumes are for playing, my sweet. For sleeping, we wear something soft and cosy.
What do we wear to bed? Do you know?
Pajamas!
That's right! Your costume can rest on the chair, right next to you.
Look, Mama! My soft blue pajamas have little white dots, like tiny stars!
Let's do our sleepy stretch. Reach up, up, up, tall like Mimi's star. Can you reach up high?
Now curl down small, round like a little strawberry.
And now, a slow breath. Breathe in, like smelling a sweet strawberry.
And breathe out, soft and slow. Ahhh.
I feel all floppy and sleepy now.
Mama tucked Honey into her warm bed.
Goodnight, Pip the firefighter. Goodnight, Mimi the star. Goodnight, my strawberry.
If you had a dress-up day, what would you be? A star? A strawberry? Something new?
Goodnight, my little strawberry. I love you.
I love you too, Mama.
And Honey Bunny drifted off to sleep, dreaming of marching, twirling, and twinkly stars.
Now it's your turn, little one. Close your eyes, and have the sweetest dreams.

scenes.title: Ollie Owl's Night-Time Sounds
scenes.subtitle: A Bedtime Story  •  Honey Bunny Kidz

lines.text: Honey Bunny Kidz presents: Ollie Owl's Night-Time Sounds!
It was bedtime. Honey Bunny was tucked in her cozy bed, and her window was open just a little.
Then Honey heard something. A tiny, soft sound.
Chirp, chirp, chirp.
Mama! What is that little sound?
Let's find out together. We can wrap up in our warm blanket and sit on the porch, just for a little while.
Ooh, a night-time adventure with Mama! Yay!
Mama and Honey sat on the porch, snuggled in a soft blanket. The stars twinkled. Little fireflies glowed.
Up in the big oak tree, two big round eyes blinked. It was Ollie Owl!
Hoo, hoo! Good evening, Honey! Good evening, Mama Bunny!
Hello, Ollie! Why are you awake? It is night time!
Owls are awake at night, little one. And I have super good ears. I can hear all the night sounds.
Let's play my Night Sounds Guessing Game! Close your eyes, and listen.
Here is sound number one. Listen.
Chirp, chirp, chirp.
Who says chirp, chirp? Can you guess?
Is it a little bird?
Good guess! But birds are sleeping now. Look down in the grass.
There, on a blade of grass, sat a tiny green cricket.
Chirp, chirp!
A cricket! Hello, little cricket!
Crickets sing chirp, chirp, by rubbing their wings together. It is their night-time song.
Here is sound number two. This one is not an animal. Listen.
Whoosh... whoosh...
What makes the leaves go whoosh? Can you guess?
It's the wind! The soft night wind!
Yes! The wind is moving the leaves on my tree. Whoosh, whoosh. It sounds like a big, gentle shhh.
Here is sound number three. It is coming from the little pond. Listen.
Ribbit, ribbit, ribbit!
Who says ribbit? Can you say it too?
Ribbit! It's a frog! A little green frog on a lily pad!
How many times did the frog say ribbit? Let's count. One, two, three!
Three ribbits! Hello, froggy!
And now, the last sound. Listen very carefully.
Hoo... hoo...
Who says hoo, hoo? Who do you think?
Hee hee! It's you, Ollie!
Hoo, hoo! Yes, it's me! You are very good listeners!
Mister Moon, what sound do you make?
I make no sound at all, little Honey. I just shine my soft light, quiet and calm.
Sometimes, quiet is the nicest sound of all.
All the night sounds together make a lullaby. Let's sing it softly.
Chirp, chirp, little cricket, singing low.
Whoosh, whoosh, little wind, soft and slow.
Ribbit, ribbit, little frog, by the pool.
Hoo, hoo, little owl, the night is cool.
Ahh. That song makes me feel sleepy.
Then it's time to go back inside, my little one. Say goodnight to Ollie.
Goodnight, Ollie! Thank you for the guessing game!
Goodnight, Honey. Sweet dreams. Hoo, hoo.
Mama tucked Honey back into her warm bed.
Let's listen like Ollie, and breathe slowly. Breathe in, like smelling a flower.
And breathe out, soft like the wind. Whoosh.
One more time. Breathe in.
And breathe out. Whoosh.
Goodnight, cricket. Goodnight, wind. Goodnight, froggy. Goodnight, Ollie.
Which night sound did you like best? The chirp, the whoosh, the ribbit, or the hoo?
I liked them all. I love you, Mama.
I love you too, my little Honey.
Outside, the cricket sang softly, and Honey drifted off to sleep.
Now close your eyes, little one. Listen to the quiet night, and have the sweetest dreams.

scenes.title: Honey Bunny Can't Sleep
scenes.subtitle: A Bedtime Story  •  Honey Bunny Kidz

lines.text: Honey Bunny Kidz presents: Honey Bunny Can't Sleep!
Once upon a time, in a cozy little home under a big oak tree, lived a fluffy little bunny named Honey.
Honey had soft, sandy fur, long floppy ears, and a pretty pink bow.
It was bedtime. Mama Bunny tucked Honey into her warm, snuggly bed.
Goodnight, my little Honey. Sweet dreams.
Goodnight, Mama!
The little night light glowed soft and yellow. Honey closed her eyes. Then, she opened them again.
Mama, I am not sleepy at all!
She wiggled her nose. She wiggled her ears. She wiggled her tiny toes. But she still was not sleepy.
Mama, how do my friends fall asleep?
Let's take a little peek outside together, and ask them. Then, straight back to bed.
Yay! Thank you, Mama!
Mama Bunny held Honey's paw, and they peeked outside. The stars were twinkling, and the meadow was quiet and calm.
By the little pond, they saw Dotty the Duckling, snuggled in her nest.
Hello, Dotty! How do you fall asleep?
Hello, Honey! I count the twinkly stars. Let's count them together!
Can you count with Dotty? Ready?
One.
Two.
Three.
Four.
Five!
Ooh, counting makes me feel so sleepy. Goodnight, Honey.
Goodnight, Dotty!
Up in the big oak tree sat Ollie the Owl, with big, round, friendly eyes.
Hello, Ollie! How do you fall asleep?
Hoo, hoo! Owls sleep in the daytime, little one. But I know a sleepy secret.
Take a big, slow breath in, like smelling a pretty flower. Then let it out, slowly, like blowing on a dandelion.
Let's try it too. Breathe in.
And breathe out.
One more time. Breathe in.
And breathe out.
Ahh. My body feels soft and calm.
Hoo, hoo. That's the way. Goodnight, Honey.
Thank you, Ollie! Goodnight!
Then Honey looked up at the big, round Moon, smiling down from the sky.
Mister Moon, how do you help everyone sleep?
I shine my soft, gentle light, so the night is never too dark. And I watch over all the little ones while they dream.
Thank you, Mister Moon!
Now, little one, it's time to go back to bed.
Mama Bunny tucked Honey back into her cozy bed, snug as a bug in a rug.
Let's say goodnight to everything.
Goodnight, stars. Goodnight, Dotty. Goodnight, Ollie. Goodnight, Moon.
Goodnight, soft pillow. And goodnight, warm blanket.
Goodnight, Mama. I love you.
I love you too, my little Honey.
Honey took one big, slow breath, and drifted off to sleep.
And now, it's time for you to sleep too, little one. Close your eyes, take a slow breath, and have the sweetest dreams.
